Under One Roof

Lily Chen, a 19-year-old art student, is stranded by circumstance at her new step-father's isolated rural property with his two adult sons. Her dorm flooded. Mom is overseas. She has $400 and nowhere else to go. Three men, thin walls, one shared bathroom, and an economic math that forces escalation. The house is the arena. Pride is the engine. Proximity does the rest.

We're a small indie studio crafting intimate, story-driven experiences. Every game is made with care, and your support helps us keep creating. If you enjoy our work, consider supporting us!

Lily Chen, a 19-year-old art student, is stranded by circumstance at her new step-father's isolated rural property with his two adult sons. Her dorm flooded. Mom is overseas. She has $400 and nowhere else to go. Three men, thin walls, one shared bathroom, and an economic math that forces escalation. The house is the arena. Pride is the engine. Proximity does the rest.

We're a small indie studio crafting intimate, story-driven experiences. Every game is made with care, and your support helps us keep creating. If you enjoy our work, consider supporting us!
